meaning: pick a finished title look (film-poster lettering)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4.5 20L10.5 5L16.5 20M6.9 15H14.1"/><path d="M18.5 2.3Q19.27 4.73 21.7 5.5Q19.27 6.27 18.5 8.7Q17.73 6.27 15.3 5.5Q17.73 4.73 18.5 2.3Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A bold poster capital with a glint: lettering that has been given a finished look.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5.5 7V5H18.5V7M12 5V19.5M9.5 19.5H14.5"/></svg>
note: A bare type T with its small serifs: ordinary letters, nothing added.

meaning: where the light comes from on the letters
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="2.2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><path d="M10.5 7H11.7M7 10.5V11.7M4.53 9.47L3.68 10.32M3.5 7H2.3M4.53 4.53L3.68 3.68M7 3.5V2.3M9.47 4.53L10.32 3.68"/><path d="M10.8 10.8L17.5 17.5M17.5 13.3V17.5H13.3"/><path d="M3.5 20.5H20.5"/></svg>
note: A sun with its light arrowing down to the ground: where the light comes from.

meaning: the light stays put where you place it
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9.2 15.5V14.6C9.2 12.8 6 11.6 6 8.5A6 6 0 0 1 18 8.5C18 11.6 14.8 12.8 14.8 14.6V15.5Z"/><path d="M9.5 18H14.5M10.5 20.5H13.5"/></svg>
note: A plain lightbulb: the light simply stays where it is put.

meaning: the light drifts gently back and forth
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4.5 15Q6.5 12.33 8.5 11.09M15.5 11.09Q17.5 12.33 19.5 15"/><path d="M7.4 14.3L4.5 15L4.3 12M16.6 14.3L19.5 15L19.7 12"/><path d="M9.8 8.3a2.2 2.2 0 1 0 4.4 0a2.2 2.2 0 1 0 -4.4 0M10.57 10.9V12.55H13.43V10.9Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A small bulb at the top of a swing, the arc breaking around it, arrows both ways.

meaning: record the light by tilting the phone (a phone tilting with motion)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="8.25" y="5" width="7.5" height="14" rx="2" transform="rotate(-15 12 12)"/><path d="M15.25 3.07A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 20.61 7.98"/><path d="M8.75 20.93A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 3.39 16.01"/><path d="M10.4 11.2a1.6 1.6 0 1 0 3.2 0a1.6 1.6 0 1 0 -3.2 0M10.96 13.2V14.4H13.04V13.2Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" transform="rotate(-15 12 12)"/></svg>
note: A tipped phone between two swing arcs, a little bulb on its screen.

meaning: how the look plays over time
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8.5 4.5L17 10L8.5 15.5Z"/><path d="M3.5 19.5H20.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="19.5" r="1.9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A play mark above a timeline and its playhead.

meaning: plays by itself from the start
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 12A8 8 0 1 1 16.59 5.45"/><path d="M16.1 2.5L16.6 5.45L13.6 6"/><path d="M10 8.8L15.2 12L10 15.2Z"/></svg>
note: A play mark inside a self-turning loop arrow: it runs on its own.

meaning: pinned at a chosen moment (a keyframe)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3.5L16.5 8L12 12.5L7.5 8Z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M12 12.5V20.5"/><path d="M4 17H20"/></svg>
note: A keyframe diamond on a stem, pinned through the timeline at one moment.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 16V5.5Q5 4 6.5 4H17.5Q19 4 19 5.5V10.5Q19 12 17.5 12Q16 12 16 13.5Q16 15 14.5 15Q13 15 13 13.5Q13 12 11.5 12H10Q8.5 12 8.5 13.5V16Q8.5 17.8 6.75 17.8Q5 17.8 5 16Z"/><path d="M14.5 17Q15.9 18.68 15.9 20.08A1.4 1.4 0 0 1 13.1 20.08Q13.1 18.68 14.5 17Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A soft letter bar melting into drips, one drop falling: the body can thicken, melt and wobble.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4.82 8.39H15.82V19.39H4.82Z"/><path d="M4.82 8.39L12.8 4.61H19.18L15.82 8.39M19.18 4.61V10.99L15.82 19.39"/></svg>
note: A block whose faces taper as it goes back: depth and perspective.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 14V6Q4 4 6 4H14"/><path d="M7 17V9Q7 7 9 7H17"/><rect x="10" y="10" width="10" height="10" rx="2"/></svg>
note: Three coats laid one over another, only the top one seen whole.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><path d="M4.3 13.8Q12 17.5 19.7 13.8"/><ellipse cx="9" cy="8.4" rx="1.9" ry="1.2" transform="rotate(-35 9 8.4)" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A chrome ball: a horizon reflected across it and one bright glint.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 6Q4 4 6 4H12.5L14 6.2L16.2 5.4L17.2 7.6L20 8.6V18Q20 20 18 20H6Q4 20 4 18Z"/><path d="M7 16L12 11M10.5 17.5L16 12"/></svg>
note: A plate with a chipped corner and two scratches across it.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 8H14.5V16.5H9Z"/><path d="M9 16.5L14.5 20.5H20L14.5 16.5Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="5" cy="4.8" r="1.8"/><path d="M7.6 7.4L8.6 8.4"/></svg>
note: A lamp up in the corner throws a block's shadow long across the floor.

meaning: the extruded side walls of letters
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2"/><rect x="8.5" y="8.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><path d="M4.6 4.6L8.5 8.5M19.4 4.6L15.5 8.5M4.6 19.4L8.5 15.5M19.4 19.4L15.5 15.5"/></svg>
note: A bevelled tile seen face on: the walls round the face.

meaning: a wet reflective floor under the words
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 12.5V8.5A5 5 0 0 1 17 8.5V12.5"/><path d="M3 14.5H21"/><path d="M6 17.5H18M9 20.5H15"/></svg>
note: A letter standing on a floor line, its reflection breaking into ripples below.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4.5 18V10A4 4 0 0 1 12.5 10V14A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 19.5 14V6"/><path d="M3 18H6M18 6H21"/></svg>
note: One bent neon tube looping over and under, capped with electrodes at both ends.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 4.5H18L16.6 19Q16.5 20 15.4 20H8.6Q7.5 20 7.4 19Z"/><path d="M6.6 10.5Q12 12 17.4 10.5"/><rect x="10.6" y="7.6" width="4" height="4" rx="0.8" transform="rotate(18 12.6 9.6)"/><path d="M9.2 13.5V17"/></svg>
note: A clear tumbler with an ice cube at the waterline and a shine down its side.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.5 18L7.5 6H20.5L16.5 18Z"/><path d="M9.6 9.5H11.4M14 9.5H15.8M8.4 13H10.2M12.8 13H14.6"/></svg>
note: A swatch laid flat in perspective, its face flecked with fine grain.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M5 10L10 5M5 14.5L14.5 5"/><path d="M15 13.2a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0M12.2 16a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0M14.9 16.4a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 3 0a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 -3 0" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A pop-art swatch: stripes in one corner, halftone dots swelling in the other.

note: A chiselled block, its faces cut flat into facets.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.5 15C7 14 7 9 9.5 7.5S13 5 14 3.5"/><path d="M5 19C9 18 9 12 12 10S17 7 19 4"/><path d="M8 20.5C12 19.5 12.5 14.5 15 13S19 11 20.5 8.5"/></svg>
note: A lock of three flowing strands: the soft combed lie of fur.

meaning: a marquee board of light bulbs
note: A marquee sign: rows of bulbs above and below the title bar.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 3L6.5 13H12L10.5 21L17.5 10.5H12Z"/></svg>
note: A single hand-cut bolt.

note: Two sheets layered, the front one cut along a wavy edge.
A page burned to a ragged corner, a flame outline licking up off the edge.

meaning: vines with leaves growing over letters
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 20C6 15 10 14.5 12 12C14 9.5 13 6 16 5"/><path d="M8.3 15.1C5.4 15.4 3.9 13.3 4.1 11C6.7 10.9 8.6 12.6 8.3 15.1Z"/><path d="M13.2 9.6C14.2 7.2 16.8 6.8 19.4 7.8C18.4 10.2 15.8 11 13.2 9.6Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
note: A climbing stem with a leaf on each side, one leaf in full colour.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="7.5"/><path d="M10.5 5.5V3.5H13.5V5.5"/><path d="M8.2 15.2L10.2 11.2M10.7 16.4L12.7 12.4M13.2 17.6L15.2 13.6"/></svg>
note: An embroidery hoop holding a band of slanted satin stitches.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3C16 3 18.5 6 18.5 9.5C18.5 13.5 15 16 12 16C9 16 5.5 13.5 5.5 9.5C5.5 6 8 3 12 3Z"/><path d="M8.6 8.8A3.6 3.6 0 0 1 10.8 6"/><path d="M10.9 17.6L12 16L13.1 17.6Z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M12 17.6C10.6 18.8 13.4 19.6 12 21"/></svg>
note: A blown-up balloon with its shine, tied knot and curling string.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 19.5H21"/><path d="M4.5 19.5C8 19.5 8.5 12 12 12C15.5 12 16 19.5 19.5 19.5"/><path d="M10.05 4.5a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0M12.05 6.9a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0M10.85 9.3a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: Grains pouring down onto a soft heap.

meaning: made of many small things (sequins, beads, sprinkles)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="7" cy="7.5" r="2.5"/><path d="M15 4.5L18.5 7.5M5 16.5L9 18"/><path d="M16.5 12L19.5 15L16.5 18L13.5 15Z"/><circle cx="11.5" cy="12.8" r="1.7" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A scatter of sequin, bead, crystal and sprinkles: one thing made of many.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 11C15.5 10.5 19.5 12 19 15.5C18.6 18.5 15 20.5 12 19.8C8.5 20.6 4.6 18.6 5 15.5C5.4 12.4 8.5 11.5 12 11Z"/><path d="M9.5 15.6C9.8 14.2 14.4 13.9 14.7 15.4C15 16.9 9.3 17.3 9.5 15.6Z"/><path d="M12 2.8Q14 5.2 14 7.2A2 2 0 0 1 10 7.2Q10 5.2 12 2.8Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A drop landing in a blot that spreads out past its dark core.

meaning: a sweeping front (letters are revealed or carried away as it passes)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.5 12H8.3"/><path d="M12 3.5Q9 12 12 20.5"/><path d="M12.95 12a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0M15.65 12a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0M18.35 12a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 1.9 0a0.95 0.95 0 1 0 -1.9 0" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: Solid line still standing, the sweep, then the same line as dots: carried away.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 4.5L11 4.5L9.5 11L4 13Z"/><path d="M14 4.3L20 4.3L20 14.8L12.5 10.8Z"/><path d="M5.5 15.5L11 13.5L18.5 17.5L18.5 20L5.5 20Z"/></svg>
note: A tile cracked into three pieces that still fit, drifting a little apart along the cracks.

meaning: fog on a glass pane (writing in steam)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M6.5 11Q8.25 8 10 11T13.5 11T17 11V14"/><path d="M17 14.3Q18.3 15.86 18.3 17.16A1.3 1.3 0 0 1 15.7 17.16Q15.7 15.86 17 14.3Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A finger-drawn squiggle on a steamed pane, a drip running off its end.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 21V3.5"/><path d="M5 4.5C8 3 10.5 6 13.5 5S18 3.5 19.5 4.5V13.5C18 12.5 16 14 13.5 14.5S8 13 5 14.5"/></svg>
note: A cloth rippling from its pole.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 20V10A7 7 0 0 1 19 10V20Z"/><path d="M12 3V20M5 14L12 11L19 14"/></svg>
note: An arched window divided into panes by its lead lines.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.5 18.5H20.5"/><path d="M8 18.5C14 18.5 19.5 14.5 19 9.5C18.6 5.8 13.6 5.5 13.6 9.2C13.6 11.8 17 12 17.2 9.6"/><path d="M5.5 11L8 10.4L8.4 12.8L6 13.6Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A strip of paint curling up off the surface, a flake drifting away.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 5.5Q4 4 5.5 4H9Q10.5 4 10.5 5.5V13.5H18.5Q20 13.5 20 15V18.5Q20 20 18.5 20H5.5Q4 20 4 18.5Z"/><path d="M5.95 8a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 2.6 0a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 -2.6 0M5.95 16.75a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 2.6 0a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 -2.6 0M14.2 16.75a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 2.6 0a1.3 1.3 0 1 0 -2.6 0" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: An angle bracket of plate metal held by three rivets.
A soft gumdrop of jelly with its shine, quivering at both sides.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5.5 19.5Q3.5 19.5 4 17.5L5.8 12Q6.4 10.2 8.3 10L15 9.4Q17 9.2 17.8 11L20 17Q20.6 19.5 18 19.5Z"/><path d="M12.4 9.7L10.8 13L13.4 15.6L12 19.5"/><path d="M17 2.2Q17.62 4.18 19.6 4.8Q17.62 5.42 17 7.4Q16.38 5.42 14.4 4.8Q16.38 4.18 17 2.2Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A coal split by a glowing crack, a spark lifting off it.
A full flame with its hot inner tongue.

svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="8.5" r="4.5"/><path d="M7.7 7H16.3M7.7 10H16.3"/><path d="M7 18L8.3 13.5M17 18L15.7 13.5"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="19" rx="6" ry="1.6"/></svg>

meaning: the final film finish (bloom, grain, vignette, contrast)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="0"/><path d="M7 4V20M17 4V20"/><path d="M5 7.2V8.8M5 11.2V12.8M5 15.2V16.8M19 7.2V8.8M19 11.2V12.8M19 15.2V16.8" stroke-linecap="butt"/><path d="M12 8.6Q12.82 11.18 15.4 12Q12.82 12.82 12 15.4Q11.18 12.82 8.6 12Q11.18 11.18 12 8.6Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
note: A square film frame with square sprocket holes, glowing at its heart: the last polish of the picture.

meaning: how letters arrive (fly in, scale in)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3.5" y="10.75" width="2.5" height="2.5" rx="0.6"/><rect x="8" y="9.75" width="4.5" height="4.5" rx="1"/><rect x="14.5" y="7.5" width="6" height="9" rx="1.5"/></svg>
